title: Weave Awards Healthcare Heroes Grant to The People’s Health Clinic in Park City, Utah
summary: $5,000 grant supports free healthcare for uninsured families in Summit and Wasatch Counties
body_markdown:
*$5,000 grant supports free healthcare for uninsured families in Summit and Wasatch Counties*


**LEHI, Utah (Nov. 19, 2026)** —


[Weave](https://www.getweave.com/) , a leading AI-powered patient engagement and payments platform


for healthcare practices, today announced a $5,000 Healthcare Heroes grant to the[People’s Health Clinic](https://peopleshealthclinic.org/) in Park City, Utah, along with promotional content to support


its outreach and fundraising efforts. The nonprofit clinic provides free, high-quality healthcare to uninsured individuals and families in Summit and Wasatch counties.


The grant is the latest from Weave Cares, which brings all the company’s community giving under one umbrella, including employee volunteer service and Healthcare Heroes, a grant program for healthcare organizations making a meaningful difference in their communities.


“We spend every day serving healthcare practices, and we see how much they give to the people who depend on them,” said Brooke Shreeve, chief people officer at Weave. “Healthcare Heroes is how we give back to the organizations doing that work. The People’s Health Clinic’s belief that every patient deserves dignity and excellent care, regardless of income or insurance, is exactly the kind of work we want Weave Cares to champion.”


“Every dollar we receive helps make sure our neighbors can get the care they need without worrying about whether they’re insured,” said Dr. Mairi Leining, CEO of the People’s Health Clinic. “Unrestricted support like this gives us the flexibility to meet patients where they are, and we’re grateful to have Weave as a partner in that work.”


To learn more or support the People’s Health Clinic, visit


[peopleshealthclinic.org](http://peopleshealthclinic.org/) . To nominate a future Healthcare Hero, visit


[getweave.com/heroes](http://getweave.com/heroes) .
